name: AFR 941 发动机失效 TCAS机动 延误/加油

cards.audioText: Your call sign is AFR 941, you are descending through 3900m for 3600 meters. Contact Wuhan approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 AFR 941，正通过 3900m 下降至 3600 米。联系武汉进近。

cards.audioText: AFR 941, Wuhan approach, radar identified, information E is current, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1004.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 941，武汉进近，雷达识别，E 情报有效，在 QNH 1004 上下降至并保持 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: information E, descend, 3000 meters, QNH, 1004, AFR 941.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, descend and maintain 2,400 meters, reduce to minimum clean speed.
B: Read back the instruction and tell the controller that the clean configuration speed of your aircraft is 200 knots.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：AFR 941，下降并保持 2,400 米，将速度减至最小光洁构型速度。
B：复诵指令，并告诉管制员你的航空器光洁构型速度为 200 节。
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 2400 meters, reduce to minimum clean speed, 200 knots, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 2400 米，将速度减至最小光洁构型速度，200 节，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, turn right heading 300, you are number 3, 25 miles from touchdown.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，右转航向300，你是第三架，距接地点25海里。

cards.audioText: AFR 941, turn left proceed direct DA, descend to and maintain 2,100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 941，左转直飞 DA，下降至并保持 2,100 米。
cards.referenceText: turn left, direct to DAL A, descend to 2100 meters, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DAL A，下降至 2100 米，AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, hold at DA as published.
B: Read back and ask the reason for holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，在DA按公布程序等待。请复诵并询问等待原因。
cards.referenceText: Hold at DA as published, what's the reason for holding? AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在DA按公布程序等待，请问等待原因？AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, they are having a runway inspection at the moment, expect to delay more than 15 minutes.
B: Read back the ATC instruction and report that you are entering the hold.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：AFR 941，目前正在进行跑道检查，预计延误超过 15 分钟。
B：复诵 ATC 指令，并报告你正进入等待。
cards.referenceText: roger, (runway inspection, expect delay more than 15 minutes,) entering the hold, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，（跑道检查，预计延误超过 15 分钟，）正在进入等待，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: The EGT of your starboard (=right) engine is fluctuating, state this situation to the controller. Ask to leave the holding pattern right away (=immediately).
cards.audioTextZh: 你的右发 EGT 正在波动，向管制员说明情况。请求立即离开等待航线。
cards.referenceText: Approach, AFR 941, EGT, starboard engine is fluctuating, unstable request leave the holding pattern.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，AFR 941，右发 EGT 波动、不稳定，请求离开等待航线。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, roger, stand by, continue your hold, we are changing the landing sequence, expect to call you in 2 min.
B: The oil pressure of your starboard engine is rapidly decreasing, state this situation to the controller, request immediate exit and request descent.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：AFR 941，收到，等待，继续等待，我们正在调整落地顺序，预计 2 分钟后呼叫你。
B：你的右发滑油压力正在迅速下降，向管制员说明情况，请求立即退出并请求下降。
cards.referenceText: oil pressure, starboard engine, rapidly decreasing, request immediate exit, descent, AFR 941
cards.referenceTextZh: 右发滑油压力正在迅速下降，请求立即退出、下降，AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, standby, traffic at your 3 o'clock position is maintaining 1,800 meters crossing from your right to left, report visual.
B: Tell the controller you have seen the conflicting aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：AFR 941，等待，你 3 点钟方向的航空器正保持 1,800 米，从你的右侧向左侧穿越，看到后报告。
B：告诉管制员你已看到冲突航空器。

cards.audioText: B: Your starboard engine has failed, make an Urgency call and ask for landing priority.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的右发已经失效，请发出紧急信号并申请优先落地。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, AFR 941, our starboard engine has failed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，AFR 941，我们右发失效，申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: AFR 941, roger PAN. Turn left heading 060, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 941，收到 PAN，左转航向 060，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36L。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, heading 060, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36L, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 060，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36L，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, contact Wuhan Tower, frequency 124.35, goodbye.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，联系武汉塔台，频率124.35，再见。

cards.audioText: B: Your heading is 060 and your altitude is 900 meters, contact Wuhan Tower and tell him about the condition of the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 你当前航向060，高度900米，请联系武汉塔台并说明飞机状况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 941, heading 060, 900 meters, our starboard engine has failed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 941，航向060，900米，我们右发失效，申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, AFR 941, maintain present heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，AFR 941，保持当前航向。

cards.audioText: AFR 941, turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 941，左转航向 030，切入 Runway 36L 航向道。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for Runway 36L, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 030，切入 Runway 36L 航向道，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: Report you have established localizer Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 报告你已建立 Runway 36L 航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 941, established localizer Runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 941，已建立 Runway 36L 航向道。
